contract.status: Evaluation design only. The selected method and all executable source hashes must be frozen separately after development and before ANY new-source EVENT values are read.
development_sources: GECCO2018: all previous splits now disclosed
GECCO2019: all three chronological files now disclosed
contract.scope: Previously unused historical external dataset. Method design used historically later data. This is not a simulated historical deployment without hindsight, a new site, or a MAWRID field test.
contract.outer_periods: Six expanding contiguous deciles, k=4..9. Test conceptual interval [floor(N*k/10),floor(N*(k+1)/10)). Training and calibration use only source indices below the test start. The exact past training/calibration geometry is frozen with the selected method.
contract.feature_history: At every calibration and test boundary, first120 rows are excluded and feature/policy state is reset. Missing input is never treated as evidence of normality. No centered windows or future interpolation.
contract.baseline: Original v1 IsolationForest algorithm with original feature set, fitting rules, and threshold objective. Refit using the same past training and calibration intervals as V4. Also retain the old V1/V2/V3 results unmodified.
contract.primary_event_metric: Confirmed new normal-to-alarm transition inside an original EVENT interval. Every original event, including unscorable events, remains in the denominator.
false_alarm_metrics: False alarm runs per eligible normal day
Fraction of eligible normal minutes under alarm
contract.availability: Report native availability and intersection-of-availability comparisons; no event denominator reduction for unavailable events.
contract.pooled_joint_improvement: On common available rows: confirmed detected events strictly exceed baseline AND false alarm runs/day strictly decrease AND normal alarm fraction does not increase. No metric substitution if this fails.
contract.stable_joint_improvement: Pooled joint improvement plus, in EVERY one of the six periods, confirmed event count is at least baseline and both false alarm runs/day and normal alarm fraction are no greater than baseline. Event counts are not interpreted for no-event periods; false alarms still count.
contract.operating_budget: Separately report whether EVERY period has <=1 false run/day and <=1% normal minutes under alarm. Passing calibration constraints is not a guarantee of passing future periods.
contract.result_access: Do not inspect new-source outer outcomes until all six predictions and metric files have completed. After that single review, no retuning and repeated claim of unseen evaluation.
contract.release_gate: No 3D integration in this task. If stability criteria fail, report the failure and preserve the candidate as experimental; do not promote based on the favorable pooled average alone.
contract.labels: Original binary labels only. No point adjustment, relabeling, expanded events, forgiven tails, or mapping binary events into the five fault types.

fold_geometry: k=4..9; train[0,floor(N*(k-2)/10)); calibration previous20% in four contiguous5% blocks; test next10%. Each cal/test block first120 unavailable, then reset features.
calibration: supervised_explore.calibrate: <=1 FP run/day and <=1% normal alarm duration in EVERY past block. Rank worst complete-event block recall, pooled confirmed complete-event recall, point F1, fewer FP minutes, higher threshold. No-event blocks still constrain false alarms; no-event overall chooses high no-alarm threshold through same conservative ranking.
baseline_calibration: Original v1 instant F1 selector on all four past calibration blocks reassembled on original axis, with unavailable gaps retained.
selected_from: Previously disclosed GECCO2018 and GECCO2019 development only
new_source_review: All six folds must complete before any outer metrics are reviewed. No model-family changes after new-source labels are accessed.
one_class: Adaptive uses normal-only fitting. Supervised fit must return explicitly unavailable if eligible labels contain one class; no unplanned family switching.
output_semantics: -1 unavailable;0 no model alarm;1 alarm. Never authorizes a valve opening.
